\ednentry{
  id = {EDN-82},
  title = {\texorpdfstring{\texttt{lgbm-\allowbreak{}basic}}{lgbm-basic} is trained on blanked copies of its listings},
  note = {\textbf{Revised on 2026-10-13}: first recorded as a measurement only; the adoption followed the same day.},
  date = {2026-10-13},
  milestone = {M3: Quality Assurance},
  topic = {Modelling Approach, Model Evaluation},
  participants = {@kadameit proposed the measurement (\href{https://github.com/mlops-2627q1-mds-upc/MLOPS_Recommenditos/issues/116}{issue \#116}); @lukas2510 decided},
  decision = {\texttt{lgbm-\allowbreak{}basic}, the candidate, is fitted on its training rows plus two copies of each with optional input fields set to what an omitted field is: one with all six omitted and one with a random subset.
\texttt{lgbm-\allowbreak{}extended} is trained as before and does not become the candidate.},
  rationale = {\emph{Alternatives considered:}
\begin{itemize}[leftmargin=*, topsep=2pt]
\item \texttt{lgbm-\allowbreak{}extended} with the copies as the candidate: better on most requests, but worse on one giving exactly the basic set's six fields (7.12\,\% against 6.96\,\% validation MdAPE), which the rule fixed before the measurement excludes.
\item Serving both models, routed by how full a request is: two models, a threshold, and still 8.57\,\% on a required-only request.
\item No change before the first delivery: the candidate stays worse than necessary on a request FR-01 allows.
\end{itemize}
\par
\emph{Why:} All six optional fields are empty together in 324 of 60,378 training rows, so a required-only request was almost absent from what the model saw.
With the copies its validation MdAPE on that request falls from 8.57\,\% to 7.19\,\%, and no tested request is measurably worse.
The test split, read once after the decision, agrees: 8.26\,\% to 6.86\,\% there, 6.81\,\% to 6.73\,\% on a complete request, and SC-06 at 1.02 times instead of 1.21.
The rule was committed before the first fit.},
  ai = {Information seeking, Alternative assessment, Recommendation, Solution generation},
  response = {Accepted},
  assessment = {AI corrected the issue's premise (fields are often empty singly, almost never all together), proposed the rule, measured and recommended this option, which @lukas2510 took.
Independent agents reviewed the protocol before the fits, adding the condition that excluded \texttt{lgbm-\allowbreak{}extended}, and the code before the pipeline run; no person did.},
  aievidence = {Claude Code session of 2026-10-13 on issue \#116: measurement, three options, recommendation.},
  evidence = {\href{https://github.com/mlops-2627q1-mds-upc/MLOPS_Recommenditos/blob/main/reports/analysis/blanked_fields_results.txt}{Measurement results}, \href{https://github.com/mlops-2627q1-mds-upc/MLOPS_Recommenditos/blob/main/reports/metrics/masked-inputs.csv}{\texttt{masked-\allowbreak{}inputs.\allowbreak{}csv}}, \href{https://github.com/mlops-2627q1-mds-upc/MLOPS_Recommenditos/pull/118}{PR \#118}, MLflow sweep \texttt{116-\allowbreak{}blanked-\allowbreak{}fields} in \texttt{recommenditos-\allowbreak{}price-\allowbreak{}tuning}.},
